unassessed.interpretation: No demonstrated evidence; not proof of inability

bands.label: Not yet evidenced
bands.meaning: Unassessed or fragmented recognition; needs a guided introduction

bands.label: Emerging understanding
bands.meaning: Can explain parts with prompts; performance is inconsistent

bands.label: Guided competence
bands.meaning: Completes familiar tasks with support; transfer or recall is weak

bands.label: Independent familiar-task competence
bands.meaning: Usually explains and performs familiar tasks independently; durability still developing

bands.label: Durable transfer at this skill level
bands.meaning: Independent success on varied tasks plus delayed recall and current evidence; not universal expertise

mastery.dimension_scoring: Weighted mean of latest up to 3 eligible, distinct-context evidence scores: newest 0.5, next 0.3, next 0.2; renormalise available weights.
evidence_rules: Reading, elapsed time, streaks and badges do not directly increase mastery
Use rubric-scored outputs; self-rating alone is insufficient
One evidence segment contributes to only one dimension; split a multi-part assessment into separately identified segments
Same task replay is practice, not an additional distinct context
Keep unsuccessful eligible attempts as evidence; do not cherry-pick only passes
Guided or hinted work may support learning but its scored practical contribution is capped at 60
Unverified AI judgement creates provisional evidence requiring observable output or review
Record artefact, input variant, assistance, date, content version and which skill was actually observed

freshness.readiness_score: historical_score * (0.70 + 0.30 * freshness_factor); round for display only
freshness.note: A scheduling heuristic, not a validated estimate of human forgetting; no penalty to completed-work history.

caps.condition: No fresh transfer task or no delayed independent recall at least 7 days later
Any critical scope or evidence-integrity failure unresolved

progression.stale_required_skill_action: Offer a brief independent check; do not repeat the whole module automatically

mastery.rounding: Compute with full precision; round displayed scores only. Compare gates against unrounded scores.

candidate_order: Required skill with expired or weak evidence
Due review relevant to the chosen path
Ready next core or branch lesson

session_templates.full_lesson_completion: Only if remaining criteria actually met

adaptation.low_energy: One bounded task or retrieval check; preserve a clear resume point; do not lower the mastery standard
adaptation.skip: Offer diagnostic questions plus a fresh practical task; map verified evidence to exact skills; never skip from confidence alone
adaptation.repeat: Identify the failed prerequisite or misconception; change explanation and task; reduce scaffolding gradually
adaptation.expand: Offer an extra edge case, alternative environment or design tradeoff after required work
adaptation.revision: Use retrieval, correction and a changed practical example, not rereading alone
adaptation.review_success: Lengthen the next interval when recall and performance are independent; use current weakness and relevance
adaptation.review_failure: Give feedback and a smaller relearning task; schedule another retrieval in 1–3 days
adaptation.review_backlog: Normally allocate at most 25 percent of a week to review; prioritise important prerequisites and distribute the rest
adaptation.missed_days: Resume from evidence and current capacity; no streak penalty or automatic catch-up workload
adaptation.scheduling_rule: Select at most one main new skill per short session; split long labs into resumable checkpoints
adaptation.ctf_rule: Use as optional practice or rubric-matched replacement, never as a flag-count mastery shortcut
adaptation.environment_rule: Offer a legitimate alternative; label offline-only skills as analysis evidence until live performance is demonstrated
human_control: Learner chooses role focus and workload
Paid labs and live cloud provisioning require a deliberate user choice
No automatic action against real targets
Assessment disputes can be reviewed and corrected

security: Keep sensitive lab artefacts outside public curriculum tables

inspect: Repeated failure at the same dependency
calibration.claim: Weights, thresholds and review intervals are explicit design defaults, not scientifically validated measurements or employment guarantees.
